title: Get a permit to trade or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before selling goods or services from a stall, or otherwise trading, in a street, on council property or in another public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 102, 4 Aug 2023); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Trading in a public place needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.
